video_title: HISTORIC NBA Opening Night Preview- How Will LeBron & 76ers Handle MSG Banner Night?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's decision to sign with the Lakers over the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: when it was announced that LeBron was going to do his decision in Greenwich, there was a lot of people that I think believed or assumed that he was going to go to the Knicks because he was going to be down the street essentially.
quotes.quote: When it was announced that LeBron was going to do his decision in Greenwich, there was a lot of people that I think believed or assumed that he was going to go to the Knicks because he was going to be down the street essentially. There was very little coming out of the LeBron camp that week as you can imagine, but about the only thing I could get was it ain't the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's Nike contract included a bonus for joining the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: he got like a 20 or 30% bonus if he had gone to New York.
quotes.quote: In the Nike contract, there was like a big, and I remember this got wrote about for years, that he got like a 20 or 30% bonus if he had gone to New York. And they literally agreed to that the night before the lottery. That's why it was so important to get it done before the lottery because they wanted to pay him with the possibility that it could be New York, just like it could be Memphis or Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' long-standing desire to acquire LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I believe the Knicks would have crawled over razor blades to get LeBron.
quotes.quote: From that moment in 2003 when LeBron entered the league at that lottery, through the summer of 25, I believe the Knicks would have crawled over razor blades to get LeBron. Some years maybe more than others, but obviously in 2008 when LeBron was 20 months from free agency, they started making trades to clear cap space.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's admiration for playing at Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: I've dreamed of playing well on this, this great in this building. It's one of the greatest things that's ever happened to me.
quotes.quote: He had a 50-point game, they gave him a standing ovation and he said it, he gives this interview after the game with his eyes like glassy, I've dreamed of playing well on this, this great in this building. It's one of the greatest things that's ever happened to me. And the Knicks are like, Donnie Walsh like passes out, and then they hire Mike D'Antoni and LeBron comes back the next year scores 50 again and he goes, Mike D'Antoni is an offensive mastermind.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's long-term interest in playing for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: He said to David McMenamin that he this is what he was looking at.
quotes.quote: Obviously LeBron, you know what we say here, we say actions over words. LeBron's living in New York. He said to David McMenamin that he this is what he was looking at. And so, okay, maybe if you want to split the hair, I think you're being responsible McMenamin, so I respect it. Maybe it wasn't so much the Knicks saying no, maybe LeBron couldn't go. The point is is that he was actually ready to come to New York and after it doesn't work out.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Sean Marion's brief stint guarding LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Marion's like, yeah, I guard LeBron for two games and then we realized Wade was the better player.
quotes.quote: We had Sean Marion on the pod when we were in Macau last week and we were talking about, we just sort of drove past it and Marion's like, yeah, I guard LeBron for two games and then we realized Wade was the better player and so I switched over to Wade, which was, he just drove past it was an amazing statement.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: David Stern's reaction to being asked about his comments
quotes.excerpt: David is looking over Ira's shoulder and reading the story that Ira is writing about his comments.
quotes.quote: David is looking over Ira's shoulder and reading the story that Ira is writing about his comments before the game. And David, and David, I can't, he is in a great mood, okay? He's just in a great mood. And he looks over Ira's shoulder and he goes, I didn't say that. And Ira turns around and says, you're not supposed to be looking over our shoulder. And David goes, why not? You guys look over my shoulder every goddamn day.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's purchase of a golden harp
quotes.excerpt: He bought a giant gold harp and he hires somebody several days a week to come and play.
quotes.quote: He bought a giant gold harp and he hires somebody several days a week to come and play the harp at sunset. I actually kind of think this is kind of badass. I kind of wish I had this vibe. He has his chef prepare the meal and as golden hours the sun is going down, he has someone play the harp.
